subject: re: Platform Game?
author: ZombieTron
body:
it is definatly more like a platform game then most racers, there are collectible smashes, billboards and super jumps. There is lots of exploring to do and secret areas to find.

There will be DLC but I don't think it will be for a few months yet.. we don't know what the content will be yet tho.

--- The Original and the Best ---
